steps.what: input_check, part 1: keep a copy of the provided estimation and hold-out tables
steps.command: rm -rf provided_estimation provided_holdout && cp -R estimation provided_estimation && cp -R holdout provided_holdout

steps.what: Crosswalk with every zone: the 252 zones without a 2010 tract internal point get the PUMA and migration PUMA of their centroid (output provided; needs geopandas and the project's TIGER 2010 tracts and tract-to-PUMA file)

Build the estimation and hold-out tables (same random draws as the original run: dwelling sets, then the 200 market dwellings per PUMA of the inclusive values; asserts the LL of the original run on both halves). Needs geopandas (bordering PUMAs from zones.shp). Optional: DWELLING_ESTIMATES=../../../02_residential_dwelling/output/residential_dwelling_estimates.csv computes the inclusive values with your dwelling-level estimates
input_check, part 2: compare the rebuilt tables with the provided ones (rows, column sums, largest difference); must print ALL TABLES MATCH
Log-likelihood at the reference coefficients (no estimation, nothing written); add --holdout for the hold-out sample
Biogeme estimation, start values = reference estimates
Compare the estimates with the reference (reference_estimates.csv)

notes: Alternatives: the 97 PUMAs of the zone-system area, all available to every record; no mover is dropped (estimation 15,163, hold-out 3,820). Zones without a 2010 tract internal point are assigned to the PUMA and migration PUMA of their centroid (crosswalk.py).

Market size: M_p = r_p x dwellings of the PUMA, r_p fixed = PUMS movers' dwellings x the PUMA's share of housing units in the zone system / its 2016 dwellings (input/data/estimation/market.csv); ln M_p is a separate term.

PUMA terms added to correct the city-vs-suburb bias: ln dwelling density x single-person household, x oldest member under 35, x ln income, and the core-city share (dwellings in DC or Baltimore City); built by input/code/build_estimation_data.py. Fairfax (VA) remains over-predicted by about 2 percentage points.
Inclusive value of the dwelling level: a data column; its coefficient LAMBDA_dwelling is fixed at 1 (Beta status 1).

Weights: dest_cov x orig_cov divided by its mean, written inside the log-likelihood (w ln P), which gives the WESML sandwich robust s.e. of the original estimator; option --biogeme-weight uses Biogeme's 'weight' formula (same estimates, other robust s.e.). The hold-out table has weight 1 (unweighted hold-out LL).
The hold-out sample was also used in the specification search; its log-likelihood is not a fully independent test.
Steps with output_provided = true can be skipped: their results are in input/data or 00_shared_data. Upstream project stages were not re-run for this package; their runtimes are not measured.
Measured here: --evaluate 4 s, 1.5 GB; estimation 42 s (coefficients within 0.0001 and robust s.e. within 0.00005 of the reference).
Environment: Biogeme scripts run with ~/.venvs/biogeme/bin/python (Biogeme 3.3.5); the build script with /opt/homebrew/anaconda3/bin/python3 (needs geopandas).
